walkthroughs.body_html:
The Sun is a star at the centre of our solar system.

Eight planets orbit it. In order from the Sun:

Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune

Mnemonic: My Very Easy Method Just Speeds Up Naming.

Inner planets (rocky): Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars. Small and made of rock.

Outer planets (gas giants): Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune. Huge balls of gas and ice.

Between Mars and Jupiter is the asteroid belt - thousands of rocky chunks.

The Sun is just one of billions of stars in our galaxy, the Milky Way.

Our galaxy is one of billions of galaxies in the universe.

Distances are huge - light from the Sun takes 8 minutes to reach Earth. Light from the next nearest star takes 4 years.

What does gravitational field strength at a point represent?
options: Brittle materials are metals and ductile materials are non-metals.
The total gravitational force at that point regardless of mass.
The force per unit mass that would act on a test mass placed at that point.
The mass of the object creating the field.

mcqs.q: What does specific latent heat measure?
options: The temperature at which a substance melts or boils.
The energy required to change the state of 1 kg of a substance without changing its temperature.
The energy required to raise the temperature of 1 kg by 1 degree.
Brittle materials are metals and ductile materials are non-metals.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between brittle and ductile materials?
options: Brittle materials fracture with little or no plastic deformation; ductile materials undergo significant plastic deformation before breaking.
Brittle materials are metals and ductile materials are non-metals.
Brittle materials are weak and ductile materials are strong.
The mass of the object creating the field.
